A fragment of a Roman cast copper-alloy strip bracelet, probably dating from the mid-third century-early fifth century AD. Only a small section measuring 31.32 mm survives; one end is sub-oval in cross-section and 2.9 mm thick and the other is flat and sub-rectangular in cross-section, measuring 2.3 mm thick.
